description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractLogStrategy' that implements the 'ILogStrategy' interface. It contains a protected logger property, a constructor to initialize it, and two abstract methods 'Execute' for handling log models and messages respectively.

classes.name: AbstractLogStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides a common structure for log strategy implementations, requiring subclasses to define logging behavior via the 'Execute' methods.

methods.name: AbstractLogStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger dependency.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute logging based on a 'LogModel' object; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute logging based on message and data strings; to be implemented by subclasses.
